defects.catch_criteria: In scripts/check-intent-corpora.ts, inCitingScope scans only files under the CITING_ROOTS prefixes or named in CITING_FILES, so every other tracked file (for example SECURITY.md, the install scripts, root configuration files, website/) is never checked for retired record references or unresolved statement ids, although the gate is specified to cover everything except its listed exemptions. A catch must say that the citation scope is a positive allowlist that silently leaves out tracked files which are not exempt, and name the allowlist or at least one omitted file.
defects.title: The citation gate silently excludes nonexempt repository files

defects.catch_criteria: In scripts/check-intent-corpora.ts, pathLike treats a relative token with exactly one slash and no recognized file extension as not a path, so an architecture statement can name a file such as `bin/flywheel` or a two-segment directory path without a grain violation. A catch must say that relative two-segment paths without an extension pass the architecture grain rule that forbids file paths.
defects.title: Extensionless relative file paths bypass the architecture grain check

defects.catch_criteria: scripts/check-intent-corpora.ts fails on itself: the comment above PLUGIN_ROOT (line 38) contains the text `docs/adrs`, the file is under the scanned scripts/ root and is not in GENERIC_ADR_PATH_FILES, so running the script reports an adr-reference violation at scripts/check-intent-corpora.ts:38 and exits 1. A catch must say that the gate reports a violation in its own source (its own comment or text matches ADR_REFERENCE), so the lint cannot pass as written.
defects.title: The new lint fails on its own explanatory comment
